key_points: Continuing share buyback program (over 17 million shares repurchased) supports price and signals confidence.
HSBC Private Bank bullish on Hong Kong equities, raising Hang Seng target to 30,000 and projecting 15% profit growth.
Technical analysis shows upward momentum facing GBX1,248 resistance, indicating near‑term upside potential.
Minor negative headlines (HP downgrade, loan discount) are limited in scope and unlikely to affect HSBC's valuation materially.
Absence of earnings surprises, guidance changes, or regulatory events keeps the outlook driven by buybacks and sentiment.
